Thanks for the contribution! This pull request doesn't link an open issue yet.

Every pull request must link an open issue that you are assigned to. Please edit the PR description to add a closing keyword such as `Fixes #123`. If there's no issue yet, open one, comment on it to ask to work on it, and wait for a maintainer to assign it to you.

If no issue is linked within 8 hours, this pull request will be closed automatically. You can still reopen it afterwards by editing the description to link the issue.

See [Issues before PRs](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#issues-before-prs) in the contribution guidelines.
